hook.name: PulseFeeHook
hook.description: A launchpad pool fee hook that deducts a fixed per-coin fee (creator tax plus 1% protocol) from the quote asset on every swap using BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta. Only the factory may initialize pools and register coin fees; accrued quote fees are held as ERC-6909 claims in the PoolManager until released by the factory.
